_doc: GX5 grade (kToneFS, docs/graphics-overhaul.md#gx5-grade), applied after the filmic tonemap in display-linear: saturation (1 = unchanged; the brief asks -5 to -10 %), shadowTint / highlightTint multiply the darks / lights (cool shadows, warm light), contrast blends in a smoothstep S-curve (0 = none), vignette darkens the corners by vignette x r^2, sharpen is an edge-aware luminance unsharp mask against TAA softening (only with TAA on), chromaticAberration offsets red / blue toward the corners (0 = off, 1 = mild). enabled false keeps the pre-GX5 fixed grade (7 % desaturation, 0.16 vignette).
